audit_items.proof_trace: The code enforces `fee != 0` (line 814) rather than `fee_rate > 0`, which is strictly stronger: if fee_rate is 0, int_mul(0, amount)=0 and the assert aborts; if fee_rate>0 but the amount is too small to produce fee>=1 after floor division, the assert also aborts. The assert is placed before reserve.borrow_flash_loan (line 816), so no funds are ever disbursed on a zero-fee path.
